\section{The handoff to formal analysis}

The assistant's useful output is a reviewable declaration and a record of
what remains unresolved. A selected declaration contains one explicit target,
its population measure,

n layer and separate private scoring information. It
distinguishes the conceptual variables used for identification from
their noisy observed proxies. Its reported results separate symbolic
reasoning, estimation, interval quality, abstention and tool cost. This
is useful evidence for a multidimensional evaluation: correctly
extracting a story's graph does not guarantee that the observed data
identify or precisely estimate the stated effect. The paper's historical
model results are author-reported; they have not been reproduced in this
project. \citep{v12_la_2607_08093}

The 2026 observational causal-inference agent paper provides a concrete
principal, actor and critic workflow built around deterministic analysis
tools and reproducible notebooks. It reports favorable comparisons under

king readiness.\cite{v12_la_2312_04350}

CausalDS expands the evaluation object to narrated synthetic mechanisms,
data and a separate observation model. Its inspected results show why
symbolic success, uncertainty quality, abstention and cost should be reported
separately. Its author-reported exam and repeated runs are useful design
evidence, not model evaluations conducted in this project. A generated world
with known truth also remains different from authentic bank data whose
semantic and assignment mechanisms must be established externally.
\cite{v12_la_2607_08093}

The proposed experimental unit is therefore an independently generated or
independently adjudicated causal mechanism and question. Several phrasings,
label conditions or stochastic model calls can be nested within that

Those fields remain unavailable rather than being filled with zeros.

cannot be combined across different model revisions, task distributions and
information budgets into a bank ROI estimate. CausalDS in particular reports
divergence between symbolic success, interval quality, abstention and cost,
